verdict.rationale: Letta's own docs state the agent harness is 'fully open source' and link to a public GitHub repo (letta-ai/letta) for the Agent SDK, giving concrete evidence of source availability. However, the evidence pack never names the actual license (e.g., Apache/MIT) or confirms the full product (App Server, CLI, memory subsystems) is under that same open license rather than just the harness. Missing for 10: explicit license identification/file, confirmation that all core components (not just the agent harness) are open-sourced, and independent corroboration of license terms.
